cards.imageAlt: Engine fire，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.referenceText:
From the picture I can see an airplane is encountering engine fire after take-off.
The flame is coming from starboard engine. This emergency situation poses a threat to flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
从图中我们可以看到有一架飞机在起飞后不久遭遇了发动机起火。
火焰从右侧发动机冒出。这个紧急情况对飞行安全构成威胁。

cards.audioText: What may cause engine fire during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中什么会导致发动机起火？
cards.referenceText:
There are many reasons for engine fire during flight.
For example, engine mechanical failure, fuel problems, bird strike, foreign object ingestion and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh:
造成飞行中发动机起火的原因有很多。
比如：发动机机械故障、燃油问题、鸟击、外物吸入等。

cards.audioText: If one engine failed during flight, will it threat flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，如果一个发动机失效，会威胁飞行安全吗？
cards.referenceText:
It all depends.
For single engine aircraft, one engine failure will make it lose power, the situation is very dangerous.
While for double-engine or multiple-engine aircraft, if one engine fails, the rest of engines will still work. Pilots can still fly a period of time, and make a successful landing.
cards.referenceTextZh:
要看情况而定。
对于单引擎飞机，如果遇到引擎故障，飞机就会失去动力，情况会很危险。
而对于双引擎或多引擎的飞机，如果一个引擎出现故障，其余的引擎仍能工作，飞行员仍能飞行一段时间，并安全成功着陆。

cards.audioTextZh: 如何防止发动机问题发生？
cards.referenceText:
First, we should make careful inspection during walk-around check to avoid engine malfunctions.
Second, we should never use contaminated fuel.
Last, we should operate the aircraft according to SOP.
cards.referenceTextZh:
首先，绕机检查时仔细检查发动机，避免发动机故障。
第二，我们禁止使用被污染的燃油。
最后，我们应该按照标准程序操纵飞机。
